title: Importance of Teaching Children Prayer
summary: Hadith emphasizes instructing children in prayer from a young age.
translation: Gaining the ability to prostrate before Allah is a great blessing. It is our responsibility that just as we bind ourselves to perform the five daily prayers, we should also strive to make our children regular in prayer and instruct them for the same. Train and admonish them; if they do not obey by the age of ten, they should be disciplined. Pray for them, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) stated in a hadith: 'Command your children to pray at the age of seven, and if they do not do so by the age of ten, then discipline them.' This shows the importance the Prophet placed on inculcating the habit of prayer from childhood. It is also understood that children should be taught religion from a young age and be reminded regularly, as knowledge acquired in childhood is as lasting as a carving on a stone. May Allah grant us correct understanding and the ability to act accordingly.
